The '''Javin Oversector''', also known as '''Sector 19''', was the theater of operations for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Nineteenth Army|19th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sulamar (Moff)|Sulamar]], who led its [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] from the oversector's headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Javin]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized in an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="EGTW5">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/22128732052/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-5|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 5}}</ref>
